nodes.title: Prompt
nodes.help: The text the workflow starts from.

nodes.title: Seed
nodes.help: The noise seed; -1 picks a random one, reported with the result.

nodes.title: Image
nodes.help: An image from the gallery, as an input.

nodes.title: Canvas
nodes.help: The video size in pixels: sides multiples of 32 from 256 to 1344, at most 768 × 1344 pixels in all (1,032,192). 864 × 480 is 16:9.

nodes.title: Duration
nodes.help: The clip's length on MiniMax H3's 5 + 17k frame grid at 24 fps: 124 frames is about 5 s, 362 about 15 s.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3

params.name: variant
params.label: Variant
params.help: Base: Macs only. fp8: smaller community weights, NVIDIA hosts only.

params.name: precision
params.label: Precision
params.help: Base: stored bf16; the h3 binary quantizes the transformer to int8 at load on M5 (other Macs keep bf16). Base fp8: fp8, as stored.

nodes.help: The weights to load: FL2VA for text and frames to video, Ref2VA for references (one folder holds both).

nodes.title: Generate

params.name: steps
params.label: Steps
params.help: Denoising passes: 50 is the reference quality, 20 the default, 4 a draft.

params.name: layers
params.label: Layers
params.help: DiT blocks: 50 exact, 45 fast, 40 aggressive; fewer also hold less of the transformer.

params.name: reuse
params.label: Reuse
params.help: 1 close, 2 fast, 3 aggressive; at 20 steps 20, 11 or 8 fresh passes.

params.name: core_reuse
params.label: Core reuse
params.help: Runs the costly core every n steps: 4 fast, 6 a rough preview. Only with Reuse 1.

params.name: token_reduction
params.label: Token reduction
params.help: Pairs video tokens in the middle blocks: about 25 % faster, can shift the composition.

params.name: render
params.label: Render
params.help: Renders smaller and scales up after decoding: faster, less fine detail. The size keeps the canvas's shape.

params.name: quality
params.label: Mode
params.help: Lossless: SGLang's default fast paths, the same maths. Exact: bit-identical to the reference path, slower. High is not offered: SGLang allows it only on its audited 4-GPU setup.

params.name: flow_shift
params.label: Flow shift
params.help: How the noise schedule spends its steps on the picture; the model's value is 12.

params.name: audio_flow_shift
params.label: Audio flow shift
params.help: How the noise schedule spends its steps on the sound; the model's value is 3.

params.name: refs
params.label: References
params.help: Images the prompt names <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, …; any reference (image, video or audio) switches to the Ref2VA model and cannot go with a first or last frame.

params.name: videos
params.label: Video references

video.label: Video
video.help: A video take; in and out pick the part it reads (2 to 15 s).

sound.label: Sound
sound.help: keep: the model also hears the video's sound (a take without sound is read silent). silent: picture only. replace: it hears the soundtrack instead.

soundtrack.label: Soundtrack
soundtrack.help: With Sound: replace, the sound the model hears with this video: an audio take or a video's sound, cut to the video part's length.

params.help: Videos the prompt names <Video 1>, <Video 2>, <Video 3>: 2 to 15 s each, 15 s in all.

params.name: audios
params.label: Audio references

audio.label: Audio
audio.help: An audio take, or a video's sound; in and out pick the part it reads (2 to 15 s).

params.help: Sounds the prompt names <Audio 1>, <Audio 2>, <Audio 3>: 2 to 15 s each, 15 s in all; needs an image or video reference too.

nodes.help: Runs MiniMax H3 end to end in its own process (the native h3 binary): encodes the prompt and any frames or references, denoises, decodes picture and sound, and writes an MP4 (H.264 + AAC 32 kHz, 24 fps). References use the Ref2VA model, everything else FL2VA.

nodes.title: Output
nodes.help: Stores its input as a run output: an image, a video or (from API 1.30) an audio take.
